configuration.rule: own: always keep the last 2 released versions of every identity group and everything a live pin names; delete the rest once unaccessed for longer than P0D. The window is zero, so the keep-classes ARE the retention policy: an identity nothing names is condemned on the run that finds it, and use keeps nothing alive on its own.

dead.rule: superseded and unaccessed for longer than P0D

kept.rule: among the last 2 released versions of this identity group — releases are kept by policy, not by access
